name: Kashiwabara Yuria
source:
A teacher and the daughter of the previous school principal, who was the protagonist's predecessor.

She works as a teacher at the academy and is popular for her gentle demeanor. While she is a compassionate and inclusive woman, she is still inexperienced and immature as an educator.

Nevertheless, she holds a strong educational philosophy modeled after her father and an ideal of how an educator should be, taking great pride in the teaching profession.

An enthusiastic teacher who works hard to teach and guide her students as their mentor.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1361154]Getchu[/url]]
